snippet.title: Every lyric is a weapon 🎵⚔️ | Tied to the Beat Demo April 27
snippet.description:
A rhythm survivor where the lyrics of any song become real gameplay effects — fire, ice, bears, lasers. 200+ effects. Import YOUR music.
